svg.title: Tomographic imaging at Diamond Light Source
svg.desc: 32 beamlines in total. Three imaging-dedicated beamlines: DIAD–K11, I13 and I12. Experiment types include full-field 180-degree tomography, double field of view and 360-degree scans, 4D time-lapse tomography, helical scans, limited-angle and missing-wedge tomography, laminography, phase-contrast imaging, ptycho-tomography and raster scans for XRF and X-ray absorption.

g.text: Tomographic imaging at Diamond Light Source
Tomographic data collected at three X-ray imaging-dedicated beamlines
Full-field tomography: 180° scans (mono, pink, white spectrum)
Raster scans: XRF and X-ray absorption
